verdict.rationale: GitCafe rulesets can protect branches or tags by requiring pull requests, reviews, passing checks and CODEOWNERS approval, with an evaluate-only mode. That gives a form of change approval before code lands, but it is merge gating rather than release or deployment approval. Nothing in the evidence covers deployment tracking or linking incidents to deployments. Missing for 10: deployment records or environments, incident-to-deployment mapping, release- or deployment-level approval gates, independent corroboration.
